commits.message: adjust netlify.toml for the website base directory
commits.body:
The Netlify site sets base = website/, so the build runs from there:
the previous command looked for src/ under website/ and failed with
"cp: cannot stat 'src/crystal-alert.js'", and publish = "website"
resolved to website/website.

Make the config base-aware: base = "website", publish = ".", and copy
the library source from ../src into vendor/.

commits.message:
fix(website): serve the demo assets from the publish directory

Netlify publishes website/, but the page loaded the library from
../src/, which sits outside the publish directory and 404s in
production -- so every demo button threw "Crystal is not defined".

- netlify.toml: copy the library source and themes into website/vendor/
  as a build step; set publish = "website"
- website/index.html: load crystal-alert.js/.css from vendor/ and point
  setThemePath() at vendor/themes/
- website/index.html: assign window.Crystal, since the library declares
  the singleton with const and inline onclick handlers cannot see it
- website/.gitignore: ignore the generated vendor/ directory

commits.message:
fix(ci): pin auto-install-peers to match the lockfile

The committed pnpm-lock.yaml records settings.autoInstallPeers=false
(it was generated on a machine whose global pnpm config sets it). CI
has no such global config, so pnpm 10 falls back to its default of
true and aborts the frozen install with ERR_PNPM_LOCKFILE_CONFIG_MISMATCH.

Pin the value in the project .npmrc so every environment resolves the
same setting the lockfile was built with.

commits.message:
test: bootstrap Vitest smoke suite

Add a lightweight test runner so features can close on green tests.

- package.json: `test` script (`vitest run`); devDeps vitest, jsdom
- vitest.config.js: jsdom environment, tests/**/*.test.js
- tests/smoke.test.js: loads crystal-alert.js and asserts the public
  API (Crystal singleton, fire(), toast()) without touching the source
- pnpm-workspace.yaml: pin the repo as its own workspace root so local
  installs keep the lockfile in sync
- .npmrc: local trust-policy override so a clean install resolves

commits.message:
refactor: move library source under src/

Separate the library source from packaging, website and meta files.
No behavior change; the published bundle is byte-identical.

- src/: crystal-alert.js, crystal-alert-styles.css, themes/ (moved
  with rename detection, history preserved)
- package.json: build scripts read inputs from src/; `files` whitelist
  is now ["dist/", "src/"]; dist/ output names and contents unchanged
- website/index.html: local <link>/<script> point to ../src/ (the
  jsdelivr CDN URLs are untouched)
- tests/smoke.test.js: load the source from ../src/
- .npmignore: keep website/, progress/, docs/ out of the package

ci: automate changelog and releases

- .github/workflows/changelog.yml: on push to develop, regenerate the
  Unreleased section of CHANGELOG.md and docs/changelog.json with
  git-cliff and commit it back
- .github/workflows/release.yml: on push to main, compute the next
  semver from conventional commits, cut the versioned changelog, tag
  vX.Y.Z, publish the GitHub Release and fast-forward develop
- cliff.toml: git-cliff config (conventional commits, section groups,
  Unreleased rendering)
